Reprojects a vector to another coordinate reference system.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** CRS, Reprojection, Vector<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorReprojector`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector that has to be reprojected, or with the wrapper a folder of vectors. |
| `pCode` | CRS code |  |  | The code defining the target coordinate reference system, composed by authority and code number (ex. EPSG:32632). |
| `doLongitudeFirst` | Boolean |  |  | The longitude as first axis of a lat/long output (default); false for the axis order of the EPSG definition, the latitude first for EPSG:4326. |
| `pForceCode` | CRS code |  |  | An optional coordinate reference system to give to the input vector, if it has none or a wrong one, composed by authority and code number (ex. EPSG:3003). |
| `doLenient` | boolean |  | `true` | Switch that set to true allows for some error due to different datums. If set to false, it won't reproject without Bursa Wolf parameters. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outVector` | output file |  | The output reprojected vector. |
